entries.ai_recommendation_summary: Use an Always-On Sandbox for immediate shared read-only API exploration.
entries.rationale: Cisco provides Always-On Sandboxes for developers to explore APIs without the need for setup or configuration. These sandboxes are pre-configured and available at all times, making them ideal for quick testing and learning.

entries.ai_recommendation_summary: Use a Reservation Sandbox for private administrative configuration testing.
entries.rationale: Reservation Sandboxes allow users to have exclusive access to a sandbox environment for private testing and configuration work, ensuring that their changes do not affect other developers.

entries.ai_recommendation_summary: Use a Learning Lab for structured beginner guidance before independent work.
entries.rationale: Learning Labs provide structured, guided learning experiences for beginners to get started with network automation before moving on to independent work.

entries.ai_recommendation_summary: Use Cisco Code Exchange to examine reusable network automation repositories.
entries.rationale: Cisco Code Exchange is a platform where developers can share and discover reusable network automation scripts and code snippets.
